title: UnanimousSleep
description: Unanimous Sleep is a plugin that allows any player to attempt to sleep, and any other player to cancel the sleep if they need the night time or thunderstorm.
body:
UnanimousSleep is a plugin written to override Minecraft's built-in playerSleepingPercentage gamerule, to instead skip the night if just 1 person is sleeping, as long as no online players cancel the sleep.

Sleeping is PER WORLD, and as such, so is this plugin. If your server has multiple worlds where players are able to sleep, this will operate independently in those worlds. When any player enters a bed, all online players in that world will be notified via Action Bar, and will have 5 seconds to run the /cancelsleep command. If the command is not run, night will skip. The player who entered the bed can also cancel the sleeping by simply exiting the bed.

There is one permission node for players that allows players to cancel sleep: `unanimoussleep.cancel`

View the project on github [here](https://github.com/stuffyerface/UnanimousSleep).
